candidate.rollback: Remove the checkpoint from context projection and response planning; no stored objective or serving pointer is changed.

experiment.uncertainty_rule: Wilson 95% lower bound must exceed the historical baseline rate.

falsifier: Fewer than 20 eligible prospective episodes, success rate below 0.75, Wilson lower bound not above baseline, any critical identity regression, or independent-evaluator rejection.
mechanism: Before responding at a possible transition, materialize the active objective, requested transition, cycle/benchmark relationship, next action, and at most one unresolved clarification.
statement: Binding objective and cycle identity before a scope transition will reduce assistant-caused workflow repair turns.
